# PhysicsBoxCast 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsBoxCast:Int32 x1:Float32, y1:Float32, z1:Float32, x2:Float32, y2:Float32, z2:Float32, half_x:Float32, half_y:Float32, half_z:Float32, pitch:Float32=0, yaw:Float32=0, roll:Float32=0, mask_low:Int32=-1, mask_high:Int32=-1, sensors:Int32=0, world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape starts, x. This is the centre of the shape. |
| `y1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape starts, y. |
| `z1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape starts, z. |
| `x2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape ends, x. Bodies beyond this are not hit. |
| `y2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape ends, y. |
| `z2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the shape ends, z. |
| `half_x` | In | Float32 | required | The half size of the box along x. |
| `half_y` | In | Float32 | required | The half size of the box along y. |
| `half_z` | In | Float32 | required | The half size of the box along z. |
| `pitch` | In | Float32 | `0` | The turn of the box around x, in degrees, as `TurnEntity` takes them. 0 (default) is not turned. |
| `yaw` | In | Float32 | `0` | The turn around y, in degrees. 0 (default) is not turned. |
| `roll` | In | Float32 | `0` | The turn around z, in degrees. 0 (default) is not turned. |
| `mask_low` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `mask_high` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `sensors` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out. |
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

**Returns:** The entity of the body that was hit, or 0 if there is none.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Moves a box (lined up with the world unless it is given a turn) from one point to another through the bodies of a physics world and returns the first body that it touches. It is a ray with a size, which is what a program needs for its own ground checks, wall sliding, camera collision and projectiles. All points are in the world. It sees the bodies as `PhysicsUpdate` last left them (`PhysicsUpdate 0` takes over moves without a step), but not legacy colliders or the meshes of `LinePick`.

What was hit is kept for `GetPhysicsHitEntity`, `GetPhysicsHitX`, `GetPhysicsHitY`, `GetPhysicsHitZ`, `GetPhysicsHitNX`, `GetPhysicsHitNY`, `GetPhysicsHitNZ` and `GetPhysicsHitDistance` until the next ray, shape or point query. The point is where the shape touched, the normal points out of the body and the distance is how far the centre of the shape went. A shape that starts inside a body hits it at distance 0.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
body = PhysicsBoxCast(0, 1, 0, 10, 1, 0, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
If body Then Print "Wall after " + GetPhysicsHitDistance()
```
